name: camelid-evals
description: A multi-layer evaluation framework for the Camelid local inference engine: self-conformance auditing against its own declared API contract, evidence-vs-claim auditing against its real compatibility ledger, and a historical bug-regression museum — plus scaffolded (not-yet-executable) skills for agent/security/RAG/multimodal/hardware-parity evaluation, pending a live, tool-executing Camelid instance.
